instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL BUG FIX: The current codebase references CSS variables that were never defined (--primary, --success, --danger, --text-secondary, --text, --info, --bg). You MUST alias these in your styles or CSS file to map to the real tokens: --primary to --brand/orange (#D35400), --success to --green (#27AE60), --danger to --red (#C0392B), --text to --ink (#1A1A1A), --text-secondary to --ink-2 (#5C5A56), --bg to --bone (#FDFCF8), --info to --blue (#2980B9).
CRITICAL: Do not introduce a dark theme. The user explicitly stated they don't like being in a black screen.
CRITICAL: This is a styling polish, NOT a full rewrite. Elevate the existing layout using the defined shadows, typography, and spacing.
Do not use complete transparent background in headers, overlays, or dropdowns. Use solid backgrounds or glassmorphism (backdrop-blur with solid white tint).
Preserve the 'accordion style / coffee shop Instagram feed' aesthetic by using clean cards with high-quality borders and padding.

headings.usage: Use for primary page headers (H1), major section titles (H2), and brand moments. Allows for elegant, editorial feel. Keep letter-spacing slightly tight.

body.usage: Use for all UI elements, buttons, standard card descriptions, and navigation. Highly readable, modern, and clean.

data_and_numbers.usage: Use exclusively for ROAS metrics, money counters, analytics data, and dates to instill a high-trust, technical precision feel.

spacing_and_layout.general: Use generous spacing. Standard padding inside main cards should be p-6 or p-8. Gap between sections should be gap-8 or gap-12.
spacing_and_layout.card_style: Neumorphic/Tactile variant adapted for Light Mode. White background, crisp 1px border (#E8E6DF), rounded-lg, with the ambient_lift shadow.
spacing_and_layout.page_container: Max-width optimized (max-w-7xl), centered, with px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 padding.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), bg-[#D35400], text-white, hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform, hover:shadow-lg.
buttons.secondary: Pill-shaped, bg-white, border border-[#E8E6DF], text-[#1A1A1A], hover:bg-[#F4F1EA].

content_calendar.description: Weekly grid of planned posts with 'add weeks ahead' capability.
content_calendar.layout: CSS Grid (grid-cols-7) for desktop. Header shows days of the week. Sticky top control for 'Week of X'.
content_calendar.card_items: Small, dense cards inside grid cells. bg-white with a left-border strip indicating the social channel (e.g., Pink for Instagram, Blue for Facebook). Text should use Manrope text-xs.
content_calendar.add_weeks_ahead: A ghost button at the bottom or top right (e.g., '+ Plan Next Week') that expands the grid vertically.

local_market_intelligence.description: Event cards feeding actionable ad suggestions.
local_market_intelligence.layout: Flexbox row (or stack on mobile). Left side: 'Event Card' (e.g., Baseball icon, Date, 'Little League Regionals'). Middle: Visual connector (e.g., an arrow or dashed line). Right side: 'Action Card' (e.g., 'Shift $50 to Google Maps Pin Boost').
local_market_intelligence.visuals: Event card should use bg-[#F4F1EA]. Action card should have a subtle border of --brand (#D35400) to highlight the revenue-generating action. Include a '1-Click Approve' button.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards should use hover:-translate-y-1 and transition-all duration-300 ease-out. Buttons should scale slightly (hover:scale-105).
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Use Framer Motion to stagger the entrance of cards. initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}, animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}, transition={{ staggerChildren: 0.1 }}.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use --ink (#1A1A1A) on white/bone backgrounds.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='calendar-next-week-btn').

brand_asset_vault.description: Latte, croissant, and book on cafe table. Use this to mock the Brand Asset Vault aesthetic for the coffee shop.
Warmly lit cafe seating area. Use for additional social media post drafts.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
DO NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties like transition-transform or transition-colors.
Ensure every interactive element has a clear hover state and data-testid.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) for icons. Use proper icon libraries like Lucide or Phosphor.
